en.headline: asset-inventory releases, meld-deepresearch milestones, cross-repo bug reports
en.teaser: 17 asset-inventory releases and 16 merged PRs lead the window, alongside four meld-deepresearch releases and a steady stream of upstream bug reports.
en.overview:
Between 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-17 the account recorded **335 own commits** plus 281 automated commits, 25 pull requests, 52 issues and no reviews. Most of the writing happened in three repositories: asset-inventory, the profile repository sogeisetsu, and meld-deepresearch.

sogeisetsu/asset-inventory was the busiest project, shipping 17 releases from v1.3.0 through v1.15.0 together with 16 PRs. The releases added an English-first restructure with bilingual docs, automated documentation checks in CI, glossary coverage for seven languages, Material-styled rendered sample pages, MCP enumeration and `update.ps1` fixes, install via skills.sh, a registry-first host-command scan, and hardening around MCP probing and provenance rules.

meld-deepresearch delivered four releases, v0.1.0 to v0.4.0, that grew the project from a single skill into a family of three cooperating skills, added a bilingual GitHub Pages landing page, introduced a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the six gates, and tightened the blocked-source handling rules. The profile repository sogeisetsu carried 83 own commits and 276 automated commits for the activity card and daily update workflows, including English copy, a peak/average summary, and CI upgrades.

The remaining effort was distributed across small personal skills and upstream reports: opencode-go-model-picker reached v1.0.0 and later v1.4.0 with agent-discovery scripts and proxy-aware helpers, while opencode-agent-sandbox and myBlog saw smaller updates. A large share of issues and discussions went upstream to openchamber, anomalyco/opencode, antongulin/opencode-skill-creator and others, covering OpenCode V2 compatibility, MCP child processes, image-input rejections and context panel bugs. All 30 days carry data.

Because earlier dates were reconstructed via GitHub Search, that portion is approximate: star counts are unavailable and releases cover only the user's own repositories.

highlights.text: v1.7.0 added seven languages, a Material docs site and rendered examples, then merged.
17 releases were published, from v1.3.0 up to v1.15.0.
Four releases shipped, v0.1.0 through v0.4.0, ending with the thin meld.py CLI.
The first stable release, v1.0.0, introduced plan-aware model allocation with fallback chains.
Reported orphaned MCP child processes after deleting a multi-run, where git worktree remove --force then fails.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects images with HTTP 400.
Reported an OpenCode V2 compatibility break where the plugin fails to load with PluginModule.LoadError.
Opened a listing request to add the sogeisetsu/asset-inventory skill to the directory.

byRepo.text: 139 own commits and no automated commits, 16 PRs, 17 releases, no issues or reviews. The 17 releases ran from v1.3.0 to v1.15.0: an English-first restructure with a paired Chinese doc set, a PR-triggered docs check, glossary coverage for ko/ru/ar/es, Material-rendered bilingual sample pages, fixes for MCP enumeration and `update.ps1`, a registry-first host-command scan, install via `npx skills add`, and security guards on discovery.

83 own commits plus 276 automated commits, no PRs, issues or releases. Work focused on the profile activity card and its daily workflow: all copy switched to English, a peak/average summary replaced the chart note, a 30-day activity card with automatic daily updates, rolling two-hour report refreshes, manual date input via workflow_dispatch, CI upgrades to checkout/setup-node v7, and fixes so the statistics and breakdowns agree.

76 own commits and no automated commits, four releases, no PRs or issues. Releases v0.1.0 through v0.4.0 added a bilingual GitHub Pages landing page with light/dark themes, first-class observations as an evidence type with C1-C8 fixes, the M1 skill contract with four reference documents, validation scripts and CI, three cooperating skills, blocked-source handling rules, and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping all six gates.

No commits, PRs or releases, but 28 issues. Reports covered the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message input, browser captures exported at 1x on a 200% display, agent-linked issues that cannot be unlinked, a skipped-role notice merging two replies, stale thinking level on model switch, missing latest.yml on v2.0.1, and stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md.

24 own commits and no automated commits, four releases, no PRs or issues. Releases reached v1.0.0 and later v1.4.0: plan-aware allocation with fallback chains and a two-question first-run diagnostic, a three-part output body with paste-ready config, `discover-agents.mjs` and `snapshot-summary.mjs` scripts, shared BOM-tolerant atomic JSON helpers, and proxy-aware network scripts.

No commits, PRs or releases, but 12 issues. Reports included stale image reads after five images in one session, subagents failing with model_coming_soon on MiMo-V2.6-Flash, the Go endpoint rejecting images on mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5, the tinyfish websearch provider returning HTTP 400, auth.json removal not clearing models, and no way to run the CLI from the Windows desktop app.

No commits or releases, eight PRs and four issues. Closed PRs fixed review server disposal on plugin unload, CRLF line endings in frontmatter validation, platform-specific review URL opening, and eval robustness in parsing, aggregation and install; issues covered the V1 plugin API load failure and dist rebuilds inlining @opencode-ai/plugin and zod.

10 own commits and no automated commits, no PRs, issues or releases. The window added AGENTS.md, a knowledge base for Git and GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, archives of OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and authentication notes plus Windows path pitfalls, and corrections to outdated conclusions about subcommand lists, bundled skill counts and Windows ports.
Three own commits and no automated commits, no PRs, issues or releases. The commits added three OpenChamber capture samples: desktop-1440x900.jpg, panel-region-1to1.png and mobile-390x844.jpg.

No commits, PRs or releases, but two issues. The report described reflect --sessions session discovery querying legacy V1 tables, so it returned zero sessions on OpenCode V2; the issue was later closed.

No commits, PRs or releases, but two issues. They reported that OpenCode detection and the skill install path pointed to ~/.opencode while OpenCode uses ~/.config/opencode, and proposed an OpenCode v2 integration fixing the skills install path and adding an mcp target.
No commits, PRs or releases, but two issues. Both were listing requests asking for indexing of sogeisetsu/asset-inventory and sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker.
No commits, PRs or releases, but one issue. It requested OpenCode V2 compatibility work covering SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.
No commits, PRs or releases, but one issue. It proposed making the harness extensible to OpenCode and Pi and considering exposure as an MCP server.
No commits or releases, one PR and no issues. The pull request requested adding the sogeisetsu/asset-inventory skill to the directory listing.
No own commits and no PRs, issues or releases, but five automated commits during the window. The repository carried no other activity in these records.

zh.headline: asset-inventory 连发版本，meld-deepresearch 迭代，跨仓库反馈不断
zh.teaser: asset-inventory 发布 17 个版本并合并 16 个 PR，meld-deepresearch 发布四个版本，同时向上游提交了多项缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
2026-09-18 至 2026-10-17 期间，该账号记录了 **335 次本人提交**，另有 281 次自动提交，以及 25 个 PR、52 个 issue，评审数为 0。工作主要集中在 asset-inventory、个人主页仓库 sogeisetsu 和 meld-deepresearch 三个项目上。

sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 是本期最活跃的项目，从 v1.3.0 到 v1.15.0 共发布 17 个版本，并伴随 16 个 PR。这些版本完成了英文优先的内容重构与中英双语文档、CI 中的文档自动检查、七语言术语表、Material 风格的示例渲染页面、MCP 枚举与 `update.ps1` 的缺陷修复、通过 skills.sh 安装、以注册表优先的主机命令扫描，以及 MCP 探测与来源规则的安全加固。

meld-deepresearch 发布了 v0.1.0 至 v0.4.0 四个版本，把单一技能扩展为三个协作技能，新增支持明暗主题的双语 GitHub Pages 落地页，引入封装六道校验的 `meld.py` 命令行，并细化了无法访问来源的处理规则。个人主页仓库 sogeisetsu 有 83 次本人提交和 276 次自动提交，用于活动卡片与每日更新工作流，包括英文文案改写、峰值与均值摘要以及 CI 升级。

其余工作分散在小型个人技能与上游反馈上：opencode-go-model-picker 先后发布 v1.0.0 和 v1.4.0，加入 agent 发现脚本与支持代理的辅助函数；opencode-agent-sandbox 与 myBlog 有少量更新。问题与讨论大多提交到上游的 openchamber、anomalyco/opencode、antongulin/opencode-skill-creator 等仓库，涉及 OpenCode V2 兼容性、MCP 子进程残留、图像输入被拒以及上下文面板缺陷。30 天均有数据。

由于较早日期通过 GitHub Search 回溯重建，这部分数据是近似值：星标数不可用，发布信息仅覆盖本人仓库。
